registeredBefore: r4 history/model construction and development outcome evaluation
hypothesis: Player-specific course performance and response to exhibition deviations add predictive value beyond current pre-race fields. Racer ID is a lookup key, never a continuous model feature.

seedCache.reuse: 2024 race keys/top-three outcomes from existing cache; only missing racer-ID/pre-race source fields fetched, no old model training or odds recomputation

history.numericMeans: preview exhibition time/ST only; no actual ST/course/weather
history.fastExhibition: today exhibition time < player historical shrunken mean; negative delta is faster
history.goodPreviewST: today preview ST < player historical shrunken mean; negative delta is earlier, exhibition F remains a signed observation
history.identity: registration ID used only for history lookup and audit
history.coverageLimitation: Seed conditions on the existing eligible-settled-six-boat cache; missing seed races are disclosed, not silently treated as losses

modelRoles.current: ablation: current pre-race fields and race-relative differences
modelRoles.history: ablation: current plus player and player-course rates/counts, rolling 30/60/90/180-day form and past preview mean/SD
modelRoles.reaction: candidate: history plus self-relative exhibition/ST deltas/z, course x improved-exhibition/ST rates, relative preview ranks/gaps, lane-one weakness

estimator.type: conditional grouped-softmax LightGBM, no odds or market features/offset in outcome learner
estimator.temperature: one scalar on June conditional joint logloss; fixed candidates [0.8,1.0,1.2,1.5,2.0] chosen by logloss only

qualityGate.candidate: reaction only; current/history are ablations, not extra candidates
qualityGate.against: current on identical usable July-August races

reaction.extra: ticket first-place boat has player history>=20, course history>=5, and (exhibition z<=-0.5 with shrunken fast-preview top3>base course top3 OR preview-ST z<=-0.5 with shrunken good-ST win>base course win); model/normalized-market probability>=1.4

policyOrder: Evaluate only after probability-increment gate passes. No new thresholds after seeing ROI.

annualGate.status: NOT_TESTED_Q4_SEALED; partial-period gates are not annual qualification

selection: At most one policy on reaction: among development passers maximize ROI excluding largest hit, then buys, then policy name; freeze protocol/model/schema/code/policy SHA256 before any September request/read.
historyDuringEvaluation: Daily history updates from earlier days are permitted, model trees/temperature/policy never refit during development or frozen September.
limitations: Closing archive odds are not verified live five-minutes-before-close observations
Settled-six-boat archive population does not validate refunds/cancellations/live missing-data behavior
Prior research has already inspected portions of 2025; July-August is development, September is a frozen r4 check, only Q4 remains the final sealed holdout
2025 partial-period success cannot establish annual ROI or multiyear reproducibility
